notes.title: 【Lewd Formosa】New Game release
notes.notes:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38386317/a5834554502bef2cbc952fe97c4858a3388d96fb.jpg

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1528560/

The game is a simulation game mainly with the fox demon Vivi. You will spend 30 days together.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38386317/d94f30052f0d5a0dcc98cde17f5e7b285ed5b6dd.png

Four actions can be carried out with the fox demon Vivi in a day.
Action commands include "Talk", "Interact", "Go out" and "H".

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38386317/e187459784bf5c0090b5f38ed914e56c4695c52b.jpg

Take her to various unique places to play and increase the positive feelings toward each other.
Talk with her to understand her past and uncover her secrets…

As the days pass by, you can unlock more special plot events with Vivi.
There are also many different Hentai events in the game. You can do various positions with Vivi.

But remember, living with a demon means you might see other demons along the way...

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38386317/946396d49a85a50464dc8eefff3952f57fc190bb.png

notes.title: Major Update: New Languages
notes.notes:
Korean (아싸!), German (Hurra!), and Russian (Ура!) added to the game! Yay!

Version 1.0.8 Changelog


 1. Fixed incorrect sacred light
 2. Fixed tutorial images
 3. Fixed map images
 4. Fixed a bug with walkable river and forest tiles

notes.title: Version 1.0.5: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
We've skipped a couple versions and resolved the following issues

[olist]
 Fixed an incorrect ending displayed at the beginning.
 Fixed a bug where using up your steps causes an endless loop.
 Fixed the third-tier upgrades for the nun and miko outfits.
 Fixed a few dialogue issues with the wrong characters appearing.
 Improved and patched up the English translation.
 Fixed a bug where players were unable to access true end.
[/olist]

Thanks for the feedback.

notes.title: Final push to release
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=br_h2z4BIDQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We're currently putting together the final bits of the gameplay system. The game should be complete before the end of this year.

We will release with English, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese versions.

Because there were some delays in translation and availability, Korean and Japanese translations will be released around March of next year.

The  English ver PV (Uncensored), you can go to my twitter, and follow me.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35218066/6046701a23eff83c58a54b73bb80a1db4f0878e1.jpg

We're on track to completing all the art and CGs in the game. However, because a lot more work needs to be done to make the gameplay and related systems more enjoyable, we won't be able to release by September. Thank you for your patience, and stay tuned for more updates.
